skill_name: Construct an argument against the following statement: "Everyone should get eight hours of sleep every night”
workflow: Although eight hours of sleep is generally recommended for optimal health, there are several arguments against the idea that everyone should get eight hours of sleep every night. First, some people naturally require more or fewer hours of sleep than the recommended amount, and forcing people to adhere to an arbitrary standard could be harmful.
